name: Museum Wallpapers
author: dpsk
description: Endless public-domain paintings from museums worldwide as your wallpaper, with the title, artist and story one click away.

barWidget.description: The current painting: hover for title and artist, click for the story, middle-click for the next one.

schema.label: Change every (minutes)
schema.description: How often a new painting is shown. 0 changes it only on demand (Next button, middle click, or IPC).

schema.label: Artists
schema.description: famous: about 280 painters with articles in 60+ Wikipedias. known: about 1200 painters (30+ Wikipedias). any: every painter. An artist you filter by is always shown.

schema.label: Paintings that are not 16:9
schema.description: blur: the whole painting, framed by a blurred copy of itself. auto: fill the screen, but blur-frame when filling would crop more than 10%. wall: the whole painting on a dark wall. cover: fill the screen, cropping the edges.

schema.label: Desktop placard
schema.description: A small museum-style label with title, artist and year in a corner of the desktop, under your windows. Set to off to hide it.

schema.label: Notify on change
schema.description: Show a notification with the painting's title, artist and summary each time it changes.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system language. Wikipedia language for titles and stories (en, de, fr, ru, …), falling back to English; the interface speaks English, Russian, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish and Portuguese. Also settable from the popup.

schema.label: Saved paintings folder
schema.description: Where Save copies the current painting. Also used as an offline fallback.

schema.label: Paintings kept ready
schema.description: How many paintings are downloaded ahead, so Next is instant even when pressed several times in a row.
